business_summary: Ceepower Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of intelligent power transmission and distribution equipment worldwide. The company offers pre-molded cable connectors, cable branch boxes, indoor or outdoor main ring units, high, medium, and low-voltage switchgear kits, box-type substations, and power quality management devices; primary and secondary equipment for power transmission and distribution automation equipment such as FTU and DTU; and green energy products, charging equipment for electric vehicles, equipment for photovoltaic power generation systems, etc. It also provides cable accessories and solar products; transformers, rectifiers and inductors, capacitors and supporting equipment, power distribution switch control equipment, and power electronic components; and photovoltaic silicon materials, photovoltaic silicon wafers, photovoltaic cells, photovoltaic modules, photovoltaic auxiliary materials, and photovoltaic inverters. The company offers medium-voltage distribution cabinets, high- and low-voltage complete sets of equipment, and primary and secondary integrated products such as complete sets of pole-mounted switches, complete sets of ring network boxes, and prefabricated cabin-type modular intelligent substations used in urban and rural power distribution systems, railway power systems, power plants and industrial and mining enterprises, and social infrastructure. In addition, the company's services include electric equipment manufacture, total package of EPC projects for power systems, contribution and operation of BOT and PPP projects, etc. Further, its products are used in power distribution, petrochemical power, urban rail transit, and electrified railway systems, as well as metallurgical enterprises and other industries. The company was formerly known as Fujian CEE Installations Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ceepower Co., Ltd. in December 2015. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Fuzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Ceepower Co., Ltd.는 전 세계적으로 지능형 송전 및 배전 장비의 연구 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 사전 성형된 케이블 커넥터, 케이블 분기 박스, 실내 또는 실외 메인 링 장치, 고전압, 중전압 및 저전압 스위치기어 키트, 박스형 변전소 및 전력 품질 관리 장치를 제공합니다. FTU, DTU 등 송배전 자동화 장비의 1차 및 2차 장비; 녹색 에너지 제품, 전기 자동차 충전 장비, 태양광 발전 시스템 장비 등을 제공합니다. 또한 케이블 액세서리 및 태양광 제품도 제공합니다. 변압기, 정류기 및 인덕터, 커패시터 및 지원 장비, 배전 스위치 제어 장비 및 전력 전자 부품; 및 태양광 실리콘 소재, 태양광 실리콘 웨이퍼, 태양광 전지, 태양광 모듈, 태양광 보조 재료, 태양광 인버터 등이 있습니다. 이 회사는 중전압 배전 캐비닛, 고전압 및 저전압 전체 장비 세트, 그리고 극 장착형 스위치 전체 세트, 전체 세트와 같은 1차 및 2차 통합 제품을 제공합니다.
